name: morph-tooltip
title: Morph Tooltip
description: Hover or focus with the keyboard
useCases: In a reading list, a reader opens an article’s actions and bookmarks it for later.
On a research board, a contributor pins an important reference. The app handles the pin action for that entry.
task: Hover or focus with the keyboard
behavior: onAction reports bookmark, favorite or pin. The first action also calls onClick, so put its side effect in one handler.
